text: Welcome to #atlas-launch! This is the coordination channel for Atlas Fleet Manager GA. PRD is on the wiki: https://wiki.northwind.dev/product/atlas-prd. Globex Logistics signed on as our design partner (120 robots across 3 sites).
Great to have Globex. Reminder that their IT team won't approve anything without SAML SSO, so the Enterprise tier ($55/robot/month) needs SSO from day one.
Yep, SSO is a hard requirement for Enterprise. We'll broker it through KeyGate Identity so we don't have to build per-IdP integrations.
First pass of the fleet overview dashboard is in Figma. Leaning on the map view + robot health cards. Feedback welcome before Friday.
Love the health cards. Can we surface battery cycle count? Ops folks always ask.
Adding it. Will also do a dense table view for the 100+ robot fleets.
